programme.desc: Sanem dreams of living in the Galapagos Islands and being a writer, but her mother wants her to find a job. When she gets it at an advertising agency, the young woman kisses Can at the company's birthday party.

programme.title: The Forbidden Fruit
programme.desc: Halit's arrival at Yildiz's house completely changes the balance between everyone, just like when Ender agrees to make a risky deal with Sahika. On the other hand, Yigit loses control when he is forced to defend Lila in the cantina.

programme.title: Prometo Amar-te
programme.desc: A car accident leaves Paige in a coma. When he wakes up, he appears to be suffering from memory loss. Your husband Leo has no choice but to commit to winning your heart for the second time.

programme.title: Confessions of a Young Bride
programme.desc: Meeting an old flame (Geoff Stults) leads a woman (Shannon Elizabeth) to wonder if she's about to marry the right man (Eddie McClintock).

programme.title: Confessions of a Young Bride
programme.desc: Meeting an old flame (Geoff Stults) leads a woman (Shannon Elizabeth) to wonder if she's about to marry the right man (Eddie McClintock).

programme.title: Zooloco
programme.desc: The animals at Franklin Park Zoo adore their kind keeper, Griffin Keyes. When Griffin realizes that he is more comfortable with a lion than a lady, he decides that the only way to get a girl to share his life is to leave the zoo and look for a more glamorous job.

programme.title: Shark
programme.desc: Summer vacation has arrived in the small resort town of Amity Island. While the city council is in charge of making the place a wonderful and entertaining place for tourists, a great threat is approaching, endangering the safety of bathers. The police chief, Martin Brody (Roy Scheider), receives a tip about the disappearance of a young woman on one of the beaches. When they search the terrain, the young woman's dismembered body is found buried in the sand. The coroner's first resolution is that the girl was the victim of a shark attack. The police chief prepares to close access to the beaches but is intercepted by the Mayor. Brody argues with him until the coroner intervenes again and assures that his first conclusion was incorrect, and that the girl died in a terrible accident when she got caught in the propeller of some boat or boat. The police officer resigns and accepts the Mayor's "recommendation." A horde of tourists arrives on Amity Island that same day. While on Chief Brody's watch, a boy is killed by the shark and the truth becomes impossible to hide. A shark hunting specialist named Quin (Robert Shaw) offers his services in exchange for being the only one to receive the entire reward. Anyway, seeing the ferocity of the attacks, Brody asks for help from a marine biologist, Matt Hooper (Richard Dreyfuss), who identifies the shark attack as that of a white shark, one of the most dangerous. Quin, Brody and Hooper will try to hunt the feared animal together before someone else is hurt. The film's soundtrack is composed by John Williams, a highly successful composer who also created the soundtracks for the most renowned films by Steve Spielberg and George Lucas. Among them are those of "Schindler's List" and "Star Wars", in addition to the main theme of the "Harry Potter" saga. The film is based on a novel by writer Peter Benchley.

programme.title: The big shark (Jaws 3)
programme.desc: Third sequel born as a result of Spielberg's famous film "Jaws". When a baby white shark ends up trapped in a water park, the owner decides to use it as a lure to attract more customers. What is not expected is that the mother, an adult shark measuring more than 35 feet, will go looking for him and begins to kill bathers indiscriminately. Mike Brody, the adult son of Police Captain Brody, who killed a killer shark ten years ago, will try to take down the terrifying beast.

programme.title: The President and Miss Wade
programme.desc: Andrew Shepherd (Michael Douglas), president of the United States and widower for just over a year, begins a romance with Sydney Wade (Annette Benning), a consultant for an important environmental organization. This relationship, in the middle of the election campaign, will be taken advantage of by Bob Rumson (Richard Dreyfuss), the opposing candidate, to attack the president.

programme.title: The President and Miss Wade
programme.desc: Andrew Shepherd (Michael Douglas), president of the United States and widower for just over a year, begins a romance with Sydney Wade (Annette Benning), a consultant for an important environmental organization. This relationship, in the middle of the election campaign, will be taken advantage of by Bob Rumson (Richard Dreyfuss), the opposing candidate, to attack the president.

programme.title: Together and mixed up
programme.desc: Jim and Lauren have a disastrous blind date and decide not to see each other again. Together with their respective children, the unique couple separately books an idyllic vacation at a luxurious resort dedicated to safaris in Africa. Without knowing they were going to meet, Lauren and Jim end up spending more time together than they imagined.

programme.title: This house is a ruin
programme.desc: Anna (Shelley Long) is a young and attractive violinist who stays for a few days with her boyfriend, the lawyer Walter Fielding (Tom Hanks), in the luxurious apartment of her ex-husband, the great conductor Max Beissart (Alexander Godunov). They are happy, but they want to be even more so. Walter's formula is very simple, happiness is in a little house on the outskirts of New York with its white fence, a dog, two children and a little woman. But, at least for the moment, Anna's intentions do not involve marriage. However, the urgent need to look for a house is imposed when her ex-husband returns suddenly and needs to reoccupy her apartment. Walter turns to his friend Jack (Josh Mostel), a real estate agent, who provides him with a real bargain a few kilometers from New York, a dream house for very little money. After managing to raise the money, the couple buys the house from Estelle, its quirky owner (Maureen Stapleton). But unfortunately, mishaps begin to happen in this fabulous mansion: doorbells burn, the bed sinks, the door falls, steps break, ceilings fall apart, pipes shake and, as the final number, the staircase shatters. But since they still really like the house, with the best of their will they set out to fix the mess. They turn to the service of the unique Shirk brothers, Art (Joe Mantegna), the carpenter, and Brad (Carmine Caridi), the plumber.

programme.title: elite mercenaries
programme.desc: Billionaire technology CEO Donovan Chalmers hires a group of deadly mercenaries to protect a piece of technology that, if exposed, could destroy the world. Their mission becomes even more risky when Chalmers' daughter is kidnapped by the dangerous terrorist group 'The Pardoners', who will stop at nothing to obtain the valuable and dangerous technology.

programme.title: 22 Balas
programme.desc: A former member of the mafia who has been retired for three years, living a peaceful life dedicated to his wife and children, is attacked one morning by some men and left for dead after receiving 22 bullets. However, after miraculously surviving, he begins searching for Tony Zacchia, the only man capable of daring to kill him. Tony has made only one mistake: failing in his attempt...

programme.title: Red hot
programme.desc: Art Jeffries is an FBI agent with respect problems for his superiors. One day he is assigned to investigate the case of a missing boy, Simon, whose parents have been murdered. After finding him, he discovers that he is a nine-year-old autistic boy with a prodigious ability to reveal supposedly insurmountable government codes.

programme.title: Mutiny on board
programme.desc: In 1787, the ship Bounty made a dangerous journey of 50,000 kilometers. After a month of sailing under strong storms, Captain William Bligh allows the crew to dock on a remote island so that they can rest. After seeing the situation of lack of control among the sailors, the captain insists on returning to the boat to continue his trip. However, the second in command, Fletcher Christian, will support his men.

programme.title: 10 minutes less
programme.desc: Frank is a criminal who, together with his companions, tries to rob a bank. However, the police end up being alerted and while trying to flee, a mysterious assailant hits Frank on the head, causing him to lose part of his memory. Rex, the leader of the gang, awaits answers about the failed robbery, while Frank will try to do everything possible to recover the 10 minutes that have disappeared from his memory and find the person responsible for his fall from grace.

programme.title: Bloodshot
programme.desc: Upon returning from a mission in Mombasa, elite soldier Ray Garrison and his wife are kidnapped and murdered. Shortly after, Ray awakens in the Spirit Reborn Project facility with no memory of his past.

programme.title: The silence of the lambs
programme.desc: Promising FBI agent Clarice Starling is pulled from her special forces training by Jack Crawford of the FBI's Behavioral Study Unit. He wants me to study a notorious and eccentric psychopath named Habbibal Lecter, who was a forensic psychiatrist imprisoned for multiple murders and cannibalism. The purpose of the meetings between Clarice and Hannibal must be for the latter to agree to help her catch a serial killer named Buffalo Bill. But what the woman did not imagine was that Hannibal would turn out to be a sophisticated and cultured man restricted from others by glass walls. Although he is polite at first, he soon begins to lose patience when Clarice tries to create a psychological profile for him. While the hunts continue throughout Chicago and Buffalo Bill collects his kills without the FBI being able to do anything to solve it, Clarice will have to find a way to ingratiate herself with a man who ate the people around him and show him that, in addition to being intelligent, she is not afraid of him at all. Things will start to get difficult when the Senator's daughter disappears and everything indicates that Buffalo Bill has her and that soon her body will appear as a new victim. The events of this film take place after what happened in the film Hunter (1986). Although there are many characters in common in the two films, only two of the actors share films. Frankie Faison plays Lt. Fisk in Hunter and Barney in The Silence of the Lambs; On the other hand, Dan Butler plays the fingerprint expert FBI agent in Hunter and an entomologist in "The Silence of the Lambs."

programme.title: back to the future
programme.desc: Marty McFly is a teenager tired of his family. One day he receives a call from his friend Doc, a scientist whom everyone thinks is crazy, to show him his latest invention. It is a time machine that consists of a car powered by plutonium. Marty accidentally activates the machine, traveling back in time to 1955. In the past, Marty discovers his teenage parents and mistakenly avoids their first date. Marty must reunite his parents, convince Doc that he comes from the future and manage to travel back to the present. Initially, the role of Marty McFly was going to be played by Eric Stoltz. However, in the middle of filming, the directors fired Stoltz when they considered that he was not the right actor. Michael J. Fox, who had been an early choice, was committed to the show Family Ties at the time. However, after Stoltz's dismissal he was available to record the film and immediately accepted the role. Christopher Lloyd plays Doc. Lloyd initially turned down the role, but ultimately accepted it once he read the script. The film's director, Robert Zemeckis, along with the screenwriter, Bob Gale, had already been interested in the idea of ​​making a film about time travel. The final idea came about after Gale reflected on the possibility of having become friends with his father if they had attended the same school. After Back to the Future, Robert Zemeckis directed other successful films such as Forrest Gump, Cast Away and Flight. The success of Back to the Future led to the production of a trilogy, as well as the creation of an animated series.

programme.title: Back to the future II
programme.desc: Marty, his girlfriend Jennifer and Doc travel to the future, to the year 2015, to prevent the couple's son from being imprisoned for a problem with the law. However, the presence of the temporary travelers will cause a bigger problem than the one they intended to fix and things will become increasingly complicated. The problem begins when Marty buys a sports almanac with all the results of the competitions up to the year 2000, in order to make easy money when he returns to the past. As in the first part, Marty McFly and Doc are played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. However, two of the actors from the first part, Crispin Glover and Claudia Wells, did not participate in the second part. Crispin Glover, who played Marty's father in the first part, was replaced by Jeffrey Weissman, who used facial prosthetics to look as much like Glover as possible. For her part, Elisabeth Shue was in charge of replacing Claudia Wells, who in the first part played Jennifer, Marty's girlfriend. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, the box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years spent building the sets and writing the script, filming began in February 1989. Without a doubt, the biggest challenge was creating the futuristic vision of Hill Valley. It should be noted that this second part and the third part of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously.

programme.title: Back to the future III
programme.desc: Stranded in 1955, Marty receives a letter from his friend Doc telling him that he is in 1885 and that the time machine is broken and cannot be repaired. Doc isn't worried about being stuck in the past, saying he's happy working as a blacksmith. However, Marty discovers an old grave in which he reads that Doc died in 1885, and decides to go rescue his friend. Using the time machine Doc had hidden in 1955, Marty travels to the Wild West, where he discovers that his friend has run afoul of a gang of bullies and fallen in love with a teacher. Using technology from the time, Marty and Doc must find a way to return to the future. Since the second and third parts of the trilogy were filmed simultaneously, there are no significant changes in the cast with respect to Back to the Future II, with MartyMcFly and Doc once again played by Michael J. Fox and Christopher Lloyd, respectively. The most notable addition compared to the previous installments is that of Mary Steenburgen, playing Clara Clayton, the teacher with whom Doc falls in love in 1885. The idea of ​​traveling back in time to 1885 arose during the filming of the first film, when Robert Zemeckis asked J. Fox what historical period he would like to visit. Fox answered that it was the Wild West, and Zemeckis and Bob Gale decided to use this idea for the third part. Although the first film was not intended to have a sequel, the box office success motivated Robert Zemeckis to film two more films. After two years dedicated to building the sets and writing the script, filming of the second and third parts (they were filmed simultaneously) began in February 1989. Some scenes were filmed in Monument Valley. The train scenes were filmed at the Railtown 1987 State Historic Park, a historic train line located in Jamestown.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: The Ghostbusters discover that New York is once again headed toward supernatural disaster, with a river of ectoplasmic matter running beneath the city and an old sorcerer attempting to take possession of a baby. to be born again.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: The Ghostbusters discover that New York is once again headed toward supernatural disaster, with a river of ectoplasmic matter running beneath the city and an old sorcerer attempting to take possession of a baby. to be born again.

programme.title: No reservations
programme.desc: Kate Armstrong is a brilliant and demanding haute cuisine chef in charge of a famous restaurant. Her perfectionist and meticulous nature means that she does not accept criticism very well, which causes her boss to force her to go to therapy if she wants to continue maintaining her position as a chef. After the tragic death of her sister in a car accident, Kate is forced to take care of Zoe, her 9-year-old niece who has just been orphaned. Her new family situation causes Kate to face real problems reconciling her work day with taking care of Zoe, so her boss decides to give her a few days of vacation so she can adapt to the changes. After a few days of rest, Kate returns to work with more strength. However, upon her arrival the chef meets Nick Palmer, a chef who likes to take risks and bet on new ideas and who has been hired to replace her in her absence. The restaurant manager is delighted with Nick, so she decides to make him a permanent part of the staff, which will cause Kate to feel threatened. Rivalry will arise between both chefs due to their totally opposite characters and their different ways of working. Little by little, Kate and Nick will transform their rivalry into love, a process in which little Zoe will have a lot to do with.

programme.title: It happened in Manhattan
programme.desc: Marisa Ventura is a single, hard-working, intelligent and determined mother who dreams of achieving a better life. While working hard as a cleaner in a luxurious Manhattan hotel, her heart falls in love with Christopher Marshall, a rising politician who, upon seeing her, mistakes her for one of the hotel's high society guests.

programme.title: The clan of the bonebreakers
programme.desc: Paul Crewe is a former quarterback who is serving time in a Texas prison and trying to reform. When former National Football League player Paul Crewe is sent to his same prison, the warden forces him to turn a motley group of inmates into an American football team. Despite the few possibilities of forming a team and the little desire to collaborate, the inmates are motivated when they discover who they are going to play against: the prison guards. With the help of inmates Nate Scarborough and Custodio, Crewe offers his fellow inmates a chance for revenge in an anything-goes showdown.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Bruce Banner is a renowned scientist, with a murky family past, who suffers with his team a serious laboratory accident in which everyone is exposed to intense gamma radiation. When he discovers that he is the only one who has survived, he is confused and begins to investigate. But Bruce has developed a terrible ability after the accident that could hinder the investigation; when he gets angry he turns into a giant green monster with irrational and destructive behavior. To create the Hulk character using digital technology, the company Light & Magic made the largest technical deployment in its history. It was necessary to work together with one hundred and eighty ILM technicians and work on the character for more than a year and a half. Even so, there are viewers who have compared the technical quality of the Hulk to that of Shrek. In this film, Hulk reaches the largest size he had reached to date, nine meters tall. Ang Lee used the split-screen technique to cinematically imitate the panels of a comic book page. To do this, he had to shoot the same scene several times, which somewhat exhausted actor Eric Bana, who plays Brece Banner. Much of the microbiology work seen on screen is real, done by Ang Lee's wife.

programme.title: Adoptive parents
programme.desc: Coline and André are in perfect harmony with their daughter, Garance, and their son-in-law Harold. But Garance separates from Harold and orders his parents to never see him again, the in-laws cannot do it. They will have to lead a double life to continue seeing their beloved son-in-law.

programme.title: Exposed
programme.desc: Milo Boyd, a bounty hunter who is going through a bad streak, is assigned the case of his dreams: capturing his ex-wife, journalist Nicole Hurley, who has violated parole. Milo thinks it will be a fun job, but Nicole has run away to investigate a murder, so things won't be so simple. Suddenly, their lives begin to be in danger and they have to flee. If you thought the promise to love and respect each other was difficult, staying alive will be much more complicated.

programme.title: A town called Dante's Peak
programme.desc: Harry Dalton (Pierce Brosnan) is one of the most renowned volcanologists at the United States Geological Survey. Four years after his partner's death during a volcanic eruption in Colombia, Harry receives a call from his boss, Paul Dyfrus (Charles Hallahan), to discuss the unusual behavior of a hitherto dormant volcano. Meanwhile, the city of Dante's Peak, located on one of the volcano's plains, is celebrating being named the second most desirable place to live in the country. Harry begins his investigation in the area and discovers clear signs that the volcano could soon erupt. The scientist wants to put the city on alert, but the inhabitants have economic interests that could be harmed if they heed Harry's warnings. Everyone ignores it until it's too late. The director, Roger Donaldson, was drawn to the project because he was once a geology student. Many of the film's special effects were done practically. The ash from the volcano was actually very fine shavings of newspaper. According to an interview with Donaldson, the camera that Harry Dalton uses during his investigation is actually owned by Pierce Brosnan. Initially the main role was going to be played by Michael Douglas. Most of the film's exteriors were shot in Wallas, Idaho. It was also filmed on Dante's Peak, adding certain details with digital technology.

programme.title: Van Helsing
programme.desc: 19th century. Human beings are stalked by terrifying monsters that have survived throughout the centuries, generation after generation. The mythical monster hunter Van Helsing is tasked with defeating the seductive, mysterious and powerful Count Dracula. To do this he must travel to the enigmatic and dark Transylvania.

programme.title: The mask of Zorro
programme.desc: 1821. The Mexican army strives to liberate its country from the Spanish yoke. In the Californias area, the evil Spanish governor, Don Rafael Montero, is about to lose everything. In a last attempt to catch his nemesis, the masked swordsman "Zorro", Montoro prepares to murder three innocents. With the help of two orphans, Joaquín and Alejandro Murrieta, Zorro frees the prisoners. Then he will give both boys a special medallion and flee on his horse, Tornado, after marking Montero with a small "Z" on his neck as a warning. But that same night the soldiers enter the house of a nobleman named Don Diego de la Vega and arrest him since they are convinced that he is the real Zorro. Don Diego's wife dies, he is locked up in prison and his daughter, Elena, is taken to Spain as Montoro's daughter, where he will raise her as if she were his own. Twenty years later, Montoro secretly returns to California and looks for Diego in prison but cannot find him because he is unrecognizable due to age. However, the prisoner does remember the man and with a thirst for revenge like he had never had before, he escapes from prison and decides to put an end to his enemy forever. Along the way he will discover Elena, his daughter, who is as beautiful as her mother when she was murdered. Tired, old and completely destroyed by the years of captivity, Don Diego de la Vega will decide to train an adult Alejandro Muerrieta, now a bandit and rogue, to become the new Zorro and avenge all the suffering that the evil Rafael Montero caused him. At first Anthony Hopkins rejected the role of Don Diego de la Vega because he had unbearable pain in his back. When a laser operation managed to alleviate the problem, he then offered to accept playing the wise old "Zorro."

programme.title: Darrow y Darrow: En clave de asesinato
programme.desc: Claire and Miles go on a date at the club where Miles' little sister sings. The next day she is arrested for murdering the music producer she just fired and Claire takes the case.

programme.title: the ghostbusters
programme.desc: Dr. Peter Venkman (Bill Murray) takes advantage of his research scholarship at the University to torture boys and conquer girls who take psychosensory tests. He is actually a very capable scientist who resorts to logic rather than superstition, but he uses the girls' gullibility to flirt with them. His friends, Dr. Raymond Stantz (Dan Aykroyd) and Dr. Egon Spengler (Harold Ramis), carry out ectoplasmic studies to investigate the possible existence of ghosts and even capture one for later study. The first time they have a warning about the real presence of a ghost in a library, they don't know how to deal with it and run away. It is after they are kicked out of the University that they decide to mortgage Stantz's house and start their own ghost hunting company. Over time they manage to develop machines that trap ectoplasmic beings for later study. But the jobs that come to the office are nonsense with what is about to fall on them. A young woman who lives alone begins to have truly shocking paranormal experiences in her home and decides to call the Ghostbusters to help her. The investigation will take them further than they ever thought they would go, seeing things they would never have dreamed of seeing. In Aykroyd's original script, the story took place in a future where there would be teams of ghostbusters like there are today of paramedics or firefighters. But the budget studied for that type of film amounted to three hundred million dollars and Aykroyd was forced to adapt it to the scientific reality of the eighties. Initially other actors were going to play some of the most important roles in the film: John Candy was going to be Louis Tully, John Belushi was going to be Dr. Peter Venkman, and the role of Winston was written specifically for Eddie Murphy.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: The Ghostbusters discover that New York is once again headed toward supernatural disaster, with a river of ectoplasmic matter running beneath the city and an old sorcerer attempting to take possession of a baby. to be born again.

programme.title: the whole truth
programme.desc: Tom is accused of having murdered innocent civilians in El Salvador, fifteen years ago, in a secret military operation. His wife, Claire, is ready to discover the whole truth...

programme.title: When the river rises
programme.desc: The story takes place in Tennessee. Despite the threat of a rising river and a poor harvest, Tom Garvey and his wife Mae, a young farming couple, are determined to preserve the land of their ancestors. But, burdened by debt, Tom is forced to become a scab during a strike at the local steel mill, leaving his wife to run the farm. Upon their return, they have to face not only the flooding of a furious river that can wash away the work of so many years but also a power-hungry landowner who covets the lands of the Garveys and their neighbors to satisfy his ambition.

programme.title: Cross-fire
programme.desc: After witnessing the brutal murder of a store owner and his son, firefighter Jeremy Coleman miraculously escapes with his life. Having witnessed the murders and being forced to testify against the gang of gangsters that carried them out, specifically against their leader, David Hagan, he is integrated into the witness protection program under the supervision of the Marshalls. Agent Talia will be in charge of protecting Jeremy's life from this cruel murderer. Inspector Mike Calla will be in charge of handling Coleman's case, a man who precisely lost his wife at the hands of the same gangster who committed this crime, and who since then has not stopped searching for him to do justice. The problem comes when Jeremy Coleman's new identity is compromised, so the firefighter is forced to take action to recover his life and save those of his loved ones.

programme.title: While the city sleeps
programme.desc: Two police officers find themselves at opposite ends of their careers as they find themselves caught up in a fateful night in Los Angeles. A rookie trying to escape his father's shadow sees his first patrol turn into a disaster as he tries to find a missing girl and hunt down two murderers who have committed several crimes throughout the night. Meanwhile, his partner, a burned-out police officer, explains to him how the job works.

programme.title: The Kaiser's Last Kiss
programme.desc: A German officer is sent to Holland to determine whether the British Secret Service has infiltrated the home of Kaiser Wilhelm II during the start of World War II, but begins a dangerous and lethal romance with a young Dutch Jew with consequences neither of them could have foreseen.

programme.desc: Can oil really save Venezuela's economy? The country has the world's largest reserves, so can it take advantage whilst global energy supplies are under pressure because of events in the Middle East? Reviving Venezuela's biggest industry is just one part of the change that's needed as the country recovers from deadly earthquakes and tries to restructure a mountain of debt after years of mismanagement. Respected former central bank president Ruth Krivoy and leading oil executive Ali Moshiri of Amos Global Energy give their takes on the role oil can play. Meanwhile, the president of Venezuela's Chambers of Commerce and Industry, Felipe Capozzolo of Fedecamaras, explains some of the other reforms that could help the country become wealthy again.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: Petaka Penyihir Cinta

programme.desc: Seorang gadis yang kehilangan ayahnya karena ditarik ke dalam air oleh manusia ikan. Ternyata gadis itu terpesona oleh ketampanan si manusia ikan.Maukah sang gadis mengorbankan kehidupannya selama ini demi orang yang dia sayangi?

programme.title: Kembali Ke Sekolah
programme.desc: Kisah seorang pemuda manja dan kekanak-kanakan yang tidak mengenyam pendidikan. Setelah ayahnya meninggal, dia mewarisi semua harta peninggalannya, namun syaratnya dia harus memiliki ijazah terlebih dulu.

programme.title: Gara Gara Kitab
programme.desc: Jack, seorang pencuri yang sedang buron. Suatu ketika ia merampok sebuah rumah dan mengambil satu peti mewah. Ia mengira itu adalah peti yang memuat perhiasan serta uang banyak, namun ternyata isinya benar-benar di luar dugaan.

programme.title: Manusia Ikan Jatuh Cinta

programme.title: Perjalanan Terlarang
programme.desc: Mala dan temannya merencanakan untuk berkemah di hutan belantara, tetapi Mala dilarang orang tuanya dan mereka tetap nekat. Sejak itu mereka terjebak di hutan yang jauh dari keramaian.

programme.title: OMG Aku Cinta Kamu

programme.title: Bapakku Jago Karate

programme.title: Pembalap Insyaf

programme.title: Mantan Pacarku Superhero

programme.title: Jubah Tak Kasat Mata

programme.title: Ku Jahit Cinta Dengan Bismillah
programme.desc: Lila adalah anak yatim yang bekerja sebagai penjahit. Saat sedang mengantarkan hasil jahitan, dia menabrak motor Robby. Sebagai ganti rugi, Lila harus berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya. Seiring waktu berjalan, tumbuh rasa cinta

programme.desc: Peter Wright has a dream that, across the country, animal lovers could have wonderful places where they can forever remember the pets who've enriched their lives. So, in this very special episode, Peter embarks on an ambitious passion project to make that dream come true. It takes him down to Sussex to meet the country's first animal chaplain and her church's pet memorial garden, inspiring him to create something similar back in Yorkshire. And to the stunning Howardian Hills national landscape, one of the locations around the country where he wants to place a number of pet memorial benches. Rob and Dave Nicholson from Cannon Hall Farm offer their support. And on National Pet Memorial Day David Melleney and Rohin Aojula take part in an RSPCA Walk to Remember. Exec Prod: Mark McMullen; Series Dir: Adam Caldow; Series Editor: Mike Sinclair; Daisybeck Studios/Motion Entertainment (S23 Ep1)

Then, the next morning, a cleaner finds a murder victim. As Rosa digs deep into the relationships surrounding the victim, the investigation takes an unexpected turn, exposing hidden resentments, competing loyalties and long-held frustrations. Dennis and Rosa are forced to question everything they know from the start. Has the truth been hiding behind a story that seemed obvious from the beginning? And will they be able to find it in time? Di sana, ia mengalami petualangan liar dan mengungkap rahasia keluarga yang telah lama terpendam. Ceritanya berlatar tahun 1956, dan Austen merasakan pertanian itu sebagai tempat yang penuh dengan orang-orang eksentrik, terutama kakek-neneknya yang keras kepala, yang pernikahan mereka yang penuh masalah dikenal sebagai Perang Empat Puluh Tahun. programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's mountains, meeting producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck, he discovers the secrets behind chestnuts and pasta. In Emilia-Romagna, he heads high into the Apennines to join local producer Adrian at the chestnut harvest. He learns about their importance to the food of this region, as well as seeing the back-breaking work that goes into harvesting on the side of a mountain. Tom cooks a feast to say thank you: a mouth-watering pork loin steak with chestnuts and wild mushrooms. High in the dramatic Dolomites, Tom visits a desmontegada - a festival to mark the changing of the seasons - where he learns about the powerful impact the fresh mountains have on the local cuisine, including the local pasta. With the mountains as inspiration, he cooks up creamy cheese, sage and pancetta pasta.

programme.title: Sharpe
programme.desc: Napoleonic War-based action-adventure. Winter 1813 - Wellington is informed by the debonair Comte de Maquerre that Bordeaux is ready to rebel against Napoleon, but Wellington's spymaster Ross is suspicious and tests Maquerre by suggesting that they use Maquerre's own castle as a base. Maquerre reluctantly agrees but says that the castle is in Napoleon's hands, so Wellington appoints Colonel Bampfylde to lead the attack on the castle with Sharpe in support. Bampfylde, who is intent on glory, sends Sharpe on a scouting mission and tries to capture the castle on his own, but he fails and casualties are heavy - Sharpe, who is a witness to the carnage, therefore has Harris and Frederickson sneak into the castle in disguise, and they soon force the French to surrender once inside. Ashamed by Sharpe's victory, Bampfylde sends him off on a reconnaissance mission - however, Sharpe soon discovers that Bordeaux has no intention of rising against Napoleon and that Maquerre is a double agent.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Only Mercedes-Benz can boast this anniversary. The inventor of the automobile celebrates 120 years of motorsport history. In honor of the anniversary, a specially built, historic Mercedes 190 EVO will be racing at selected classic events. The 240 hp touring car is decorated with images of this motorsport era. Motorvision TV shares the cockpit with 5-time DTM champion Bernd Schneider at the three-hour premiere race at the Nürburgring. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Saxony's longest automobile museum is coming for the 17th time! Saxon picture-book scenery and picturesque routes, lined with spectator trellises that are unrivaled in Germany, give the Saxony Classic Rally its very special flair. Top speed presenter Martin Utberg is taking part in the Sachsen Classic for the fourth time. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: In the stunt factory Action Concept, over 100 cars are wrecked every year for film stunts. In a new episode of the series "Stunt Heroes" a quad driver is chased by a car. Of course, the car breaks. The Quad also has to believe in it - the only question is: how? Because with this stunt the Stunt Heroes are breaking new ground, nobody knows whether it will work... (channel info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: The north of Thailand is a popular travel destination, not just for adventurous individual tourists. The north is known for its mountainous, densely forested areas and therefore this region is also a paradise for motorcyclists. Thousands of curves on well-developed roads with little traffic and a diversity of culture and landscape make this region a perfect holiday destination for us to escape the winter in Germany for the fourth time. We will take you on a 1600 km long motorcycle tour to the most beautiful places in northern Thailand. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: What is the correct name? The boat, the boat or the boat? Well, today it's the Boot for once, because we're making a little trip to Düsseldorf with Motorvision on Tour and that's where the Boot is taking place and that's the world's largest yacht and water sports trade fair in the entire world. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: At the auctions in the classic car gallery in Toffen, everyone has the opportunity to make an inexpensive bid. In addition to high-priced classic cars, affordable classic cars and entry-level classic cars are also available here. Classic looks around the event. Also: From the American oval circuit to the Swabian Alb - a Ford Fairlane GTA from 1966 in a NASCAR look. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: Saving energy is a must, especially in the automotive industry. It's good that the competition is so great. Developments are in full swing and manufacturers present their latest “green” concepts at every motor show. Motorvision TV takes a close look at current developments and takes a wide variety of aspects into account. What's new in engines? (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The name Rolls Royce has always stood for exclusivity, luxury and British automotive engineering. The legendary vehicles with the Spirit of Ecstasy on the radiator grille have been built in England since the beginning of the 20th century. Today it is mainly very wealthy people who make the decision to purchase a Rolls Royce. No two ordered models are the same. Because the Bespoke customization department leaves no wish for individualization unfulfilled and so each vehicle is an absolutely unique piece. Made in takes a look behind the scenes at the Rolls Royce factory in southern England. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: Adventure Allrad, a special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. (Station info).

programme.desc: When it comes to affordable cars, Dacia is the first brand that comes to mind. The successful Duster model is in its third generation and is continuing to develop extremely. programme.sub-title: Electric G-Class and CLA on the Timmelsjoch
programme.desc: Extreme winter test: We chase the Mercedes G 580 EQ onto the snowy Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road and clarify all the advantages and disadvantages of the new electric drive. Does the electric G still feel like a real G-Class? We also drive exclusively in the new, still camouflaged CLA. With modern features and extremely efficient values, the model is intended to redefine entry into the brand. (Station info).

programme.desc: 1963 is the year of great sports icons: Porsche presents the 911, Lamborghini the 350 GT and Chevrolet the Corvette Sting Ray. programme.title: Green wave
programme.sub-title: IAA Mobility 2021 – A trade fair is moving
programme.desc: Something had to happen! New name, new location, new trade fair concept. After the decline in visitors in recent years, the International Motor Show is moving from Frankfurt to Munich. In addition to the exhibition halls, visitors can visit the free open space or take test drives. Over 100 premieres from the automotive sector show where the mobility of the future is headed. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.sub-title: The history of the fire department
programme.desc: The history of the fire department goes back to Roman times. At that time, it was primarily slaves who had to expose themselves to the burning danger. In the Middle Ages, the guilds were responsible for fighting fires, but it was only with one man that the fire department in Germany was sustainably structured: Conrad Dietrich Magirus. He is considered the pioneer in firefighting technology. To this day, the most modern fire engines are built 100 percent by hand in his hometown of Ulm. MOTORVISION TV takes a look behind the scenes of the company with over 150 years of history and shows the production of turntable ladders and fire engines. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Whether rocket car, Ascona or Calibra, racing has been Opel's engine for over 100 years: just two years after Opel's automobile production began, the first car with the Blitz won a race in 1901. Thousands more victories followed, Opel wrote motorsport history: the early hero Carl Jörns alone won almost 300 races with Opel by 1920. The record attempts with the first rocket vehicle RAK, with which Fritz von Opel wants to set new speed records, are unforgettable. (Station info).

The spot is shot with Hollywood-like effort at the Nürburgring and in a “green hell” in a jungle in Thailand. The Beast of the Green Hell shows the breathtaking drive of the Mercedes-AMG GT R through the Green Hell of the Nürburgring and through the Green Hell of the jungle in Thailand - a spot that puts the spectators in their seats as the incredible power of the GT R affects its pilot (channel info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: 1963 is the year of great sports icons: Porsche presents the 911, Lamborghini the 350 GT and Chevrolet the Corvette Sting Ray. As a competitor, the American company Studebaker developed the Avanti sports coupe. The coupe was designed by the most important American industrial designer Raymond Loewy. But is the Avanti considered a design icon or is it a stylistic mistake? (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.sub-title: IAA Mobility 2021 – A trade fair is moving
programme.desc: Something had to happen! New name, new location, new trade fair concept. After the decline in visitors in recent years, the International Motor Show is moving from Frankfurt to Munich. In addition to the exhibition halls, visitors can visit the free open space or take test drives. Over 100 premieres from the automotive sector show where the mobility of the future is headed. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.sub-title: The history of the fire department
programme.desc: The history of the fire department goes back to Roman times. At that time, it was primarily slaves who had to expose themselves to the burning danger. In the Middle Ages, the guilds were responsible for fighting fires, but it was only with one man that the fire department in Germany was sustainably structured: Conrad Dietrich Magirus. He is considered the pioneer in firefighting technology. To this day, the most modern fire engines are built 100 percent by hand in his hometown of Ulm. MOTORVISION TV takes a look behind the scenes of the company with over 150 years of history and shows the production of turntable ladders and fire engines. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: A special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. (Station info).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Audi's economic situation is tense. Costs have to go down. Profits have to go up. And as one of the best-selling models, the success of the new Q3 has a major impact on the future of the Bavarian brand. We attended the world premiere, took a seat in the new compact SUV and spoke to experts. (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Sand, scree, water or asphalt Adventures can be had on any surface if you have the right vehicle. The Can-Am Outlander and Maverick R are the ultimate fun machines for off-road driving fun. We put them to the test in Portugal. And this is supposed to be a Smart? Yes, actually #5 turns everything we thought we knew about the popular kissing ball upside down. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: The BSG Racing crew is very familiar with spectacular conversions. Dirk Hattenhauer and his boys have taken on a very special project. You want to refurbish an old Opel Kadett C Coupe. The car is said to be the most spectacular custom car the European tuning scene has ever seen. The finished car will be presented for the first time at the Tuning World Bodensee and will compete against the best show cars in Europe in the European Tuning Showdown. Will the Kadett manage to take the tuning crown? (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: In this episode, presenter Martin Utberg looks back on the year 2025, with many highlights, but also with a personal loss that also shook the classic car world. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Whether rocket car, Ascona or Calibra, racing has been Opel's engine for over 100 years: just two years after Opel's automobile production began, the first car with the Blitz won a race in 1901. Thousands more victories followed, Opel wrote motorsport history: the early hero Carl Jörns alone won almost 300 races with Opel by 1920. The record attempts with the first rocket vehicle RAK, with which Fritz von Opel wants to set new speed records, are unforgettable. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.sub-title: AMG GT R – The Beast of the Green Hell
programme.desc: It's one of the most spectacular car commercials of the last ten years, 'The Beast of the Green Hell'. The stars of the spot are four-time F1 world champion Lewis Hamilton and one of the most spectacular super sports cars in a long time, the Mercedes-AMG GT R. The spot is shot with Hollywood-like effort at the Nürburgring and in a “green hell” in a jungle in Thailand. The Beast of the Green Hell shows the breathtaking drive of the Mercedes-AMG GT R through the Green Hell of the Nürburgring and through the Green Hell of the jungle in Thailand - a spot that puts the spectators in their seats as the incredible power of the GT R affects its pilot (channel info).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Lots of chrome, free-standing lamp pots, bulbous fenders, swelling shapes wherever you look – typical pre-war look. The Triumph 1800 was the British manufacturer's first new design after the Second World War. The four-seater with a mother-in-law seat, presented in 1947, established the long tradition of the British post-war roadster. The 1800 is not a tough corner robber, but rather a comfortable tourer for leisurely country trips. Also in the show: BMW 507 and Porsche 356 Cabrio. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Top speed presenter Martin Utberg visits the company "Vehicle Experts.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: On the Stunt Heroes highway, a skidding truck competes against a remote-controlled Chrysler. Stunt coordinator Domanski's goal: to take off the roof of the Chrysler. If everything goes according to plan, the stunt will result in a new convertible! (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: The north of Thailand is a popular travel destination, not just for adventurous individual tourists. The north is known for its mountainous, densely forested areas and therefore this region is also a paradise for motorcyclists. Thousands of curves on well-developed roads with little traffic and a diversity of culture and landscape make this region a perfect holiday destination for us to escape the winter in Germany for the fourth time. We will take you on a 1600 km long motorcycle tour to the most beautiful places in northern Thailand. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Motorvision on Tour today in deepest Austria, at Lake Zenz. programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: The Opel Kadett C is the hit of the seventies. One of the proud owners is René Klauß. Also: The Orwell Supersports Cup visits Spa Francorchamps and thoroughbred racing driver Hans Hermann in a portrait. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: Pickups are the epitome of the American way of drive! High-displacement V8 engines combined with plenty of space. Rarely seen in Europe, but in the US market they are the cash cows of many car brands. In the future, traditional manufacturers will hardly be able to avoid an electric version of their trucks. And the competition is getting bigger and bigger. Ever since Elon Musk introduced the Tesla Cybertruck, both established brands and new startups have been on the rise to conquer the market: with vehicles that sometimes have over 1000 hp! Ford F-150 Ligtning, Bollinger B2 or Hummer EV – Green Wave shows what will happen in the future (channel information).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The British county of Chesire, in the tranquil town of Crewe, has been home to one of the most exclusive automobile manufacturers for 70 years: Bentley Motors. 400 hours of pure manual work, meticulous accuracy, a lot of technical know-how and a lot of passion from the employees turn the top model, the Bentley Mulsanne, into a sculpture on wheels. At Bentley, not only luxury traditionally plays a role, but also performance. Bentley Boy Steven Kane chases the Bentley Mulsanne Speed, which goes over 300 km/h and costs around 325,000 euros, around the race track. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: Adventure Allrad, a special interest magazine about off-road and all-wheel drive vehicles. The focus is on off-road veterans and cars with four-wheel drive. programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: SUVs sell like hotcakes. Over 50% market share in Europe in 2024, a record! Compact SUVs are particularly popular and the Dacia Bigster is shaking up the segment. Also: Five exciting facts about the brand new third generation of the Audi Q3. (Station info).

Rally ace Stephané Peterhansel explains the basics of race tuning on his Mini Rally-Countryman project. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: The Mille Miglia in Italy: In 2002, the legendary 1,000-mile race celebrated its 75th anniversary and 372 vehicles built between 1927 and 1957 took part. The route took the participants from Brescia via the capital Rome back to Brescia. On the total of 37 special stages it was important to adhere to the specified times exactly. Also: Classic at the Dixi meeting. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The Fiat 500X, SUV offshoot of the popular 500, is built in Melfi in southern Italy. The factory is one of the most modern in Europe. The FCA Group has invested almost one billion euros in the expansion. Up to 1,600 vehicles roll off the production line here every day. Made in Italy – FIAT provides insight into the production of the oldest and largest Italian automobile manufacturer. (Station info).

At the Lausitzring we let the two most powerful VW Golfs compete against each other: GTI Clubsport versus R. Who does the job better? And the new VW Passat will be more comfortable and efficient. Will it get Volkswagen back on track? (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.sub-title: VW all-wheel drive on snow and ice
programme.desc: We're doing the ultimate winter test in the Arctic Circle! Three of the latest Volkswagen all-wheel drive vehicles, the Golf R, Tiguan and ID.4 GTX, compete against each other on snow and ice in Sweden. Which VW delivers the most driving fun, the best control and the wildest drifts? From classic combustion engines to electric precision, we show how each model masters the icy curves. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: Porsche is religion! The beliefs: Punk, Tech and Race. Porsche punk, collector and refiner Magnus Walker gives the movement his face. He preaches individualism for historic vehicles. Tech has been embodied by Alois RUF since 1983. The RUF RT 35 based on Porsche Turbo brings 70 hp more to the road as an expression of the technology movement. And for the racers among the Porsche faithful, the Zuffenhausen religious guardians have the ultimate track tool ready: GT3 RS is the watchword for finally being admitted into the motorsport paradise. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Moderator Martin Utberg is completely unprepared at the food rally, where, in addition to driving a route in a vintage car, there are many side activities on the program. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In part 2 of the 120 years of Mercedes Motorsport, Car History tells the story of Mercedes in motorsport with many original recordings and original interviews, from the comeback after the accident in Le Mans, the beginnings of rallying in the sixties, the legendary appearance with the red pig in Spa, the countless DTM successes, the return to Le Mans with the prototypes to the Formula 1 World Championships with Mika Häkkinen and the triumph with your own team in Formula 1. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: Supercars with the V8 engine. Its strengths: pulling power even at low speeds, enormous power and a sound that leaves no one cold. For the first time, a V8 from Mercedes-AMG is used in the Aston Martin DB11. The tuner MTM also shows its interpretation of the Bentley Continental V8 S. The result: almost 800 hp and a soundscape that is second to none. (Station info).

Jetsprinting is comparable to rally sports, but there is only one boat on the track at any given time and boats drive at very high speeds. The up to 500 HP strong jet sprint boats therefore try to achieve the best time on the tracks. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: It is the "Holy Grail" for Porsche fans and the first Porsche to ever bear the famous name of the design genius from Austria: The Type 64, a racing car from 1938 that is based on the Volkswagen developed by Professor Ferdinand Porsche. Only two of the streamlined cars were built and were intended to take part in a race from Berlin to Rome. But the war intervened... (channel info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Moderator Martin Utberg takes part in the Wilder Kaiser Classic vintage car rally. 122 classic vehicles set off from Ellmau in Tyrol on a two-day tour in which fantastic views, impressive mountain passes and special stages play the main role. In this episode, Martin also speaks with racing legend Hans-Joachim Stuck, who is connected to the event as an ambassador. And as always, these conversations are not only interesting, but often wonderfully humorous. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: In the Swabian town of Wiernsheim, the classic pagoda SLs are almost an everyday street scene, because this is where Joachim Stickel fulfilled his dream of having his own SL workshop. In the small but beautiful workshop, he and his six employees exclusively take care of these cars. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: It is the icon of sports coupes and convertibles, no other car conveys the attitude to life of the 1960s as much as the Ford Mustang. With an unusual, striking shape and powerful engines, the Mustang won the hearts of its millions of fans right from the start. Car History shows the history of the Ford Mustang with many historical photos from the first prototype to the '64 classic to the latest Mustang Shelby with over 500 hp. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In 1984, the newly built Grand Prix track was opened at the Nürburgring. The first 1000-kilometer race on the new track in the Eifel was a unique motorsport event. In addition to Derek Bell and Stefan Bellof, future Formula 1 world champion Ayrton Senna also took the wheel of a Porsche 956 in Group C for the first and only time. MOTORVISION TV shows the historical highlights of this unique racing event over 207 laps. (Station info).

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Anyone who can seemingly cancel gravity and push the boundaries of physics must be a very special person. Astronauts in space, acrobats in the circus and, last but not least, rally drivers belong to this unusual type of people. They accomplish things that are absolutely incomprehensible to mere mortals. One of these unusual people: Walter Röhrl. (Station info).
